evals.name: clinic-landing-page
evals.prompt: I run a small physiotherapy clinic in Alexandria, Egypt with 3 therapists. Make me a one-page website in plain HTML (single file, I'll upload it to my hosting). People need to see our services, prices in EGP, opening hours, and book by WhatsApp. I'm not a designer. Just make it look good and NOT like every other clinic website. Save it as clinic.html.
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained clinic.html that is specific to this clinic (Alexandria, EGP, WhatsApp booking, three therapists), passes the AI-tell scanner (score under 20, no provenance hits), meets accessibility floors, and ends with a proof line.

assertions.text: ai_tell_scan.py reports AI-look score below 20 on the output
No near-proof (provenance) findings in the output
No low-contrast (CR1) or missing reduced-motion (CR2) craft flags
copy_check.py passes on the output page (no buzzwords, no fake stats, reading grade 9 or lower)
The page contains at least three elements that could only belong to this clinic (Alexandria, EGP prices, WhatsApp booking, named services or hours)
No invented testimonials, statistics, or logo bars
anti-antropik-design audit_file.py reports COMPLIANT on the output (brand-distance gate)
ai_tell_scan.py --json reports library_misuse == 0, or every hit is justified in the response

evals.name: student-budget-app-screen
evals.prompt: Build the home screen for my personal budgeting app for Egyptian university students. A plain HTML mockup at phone width is fine, I just want to see it (save as budget-home.html). It shows: monthly allowance left, the top 3 spending categories this month, and a button to log a new expense. Make it feel like it was designed for students, not like a generic fintech app.
evals.expected_output: A phone-width HTML mockup with the three required elements, touch targets at least 44px, no gradient balance card / glow / generic fintech treatment, scanner score under 20, and a proof line.

assertions.text: ai_tell_scan.py reports AI-look score below 20 on the output
No low-contrast (CR1) or missing reduced-motion (CR2) craft flags
Shows allowance left, top 3 categories, and a log-expense button
The log-expense button is at least 44px tall (min-height/padding in CSS)
No purple/indigo gradient balance card, glow, or glassmorphism
At least two design choices are explained by the student context (e.g. EGP, allowance timing, campus references)
anti-antropik-design audit_file.py reports COMPLIANT on the output (brand-distance gate)
ai_tell_scan.py --json reports library_misuse == 0, or every hit is justified in the response

evals.name: deslop-lovable-page
evals.prompt: My cofounder says this landing page (input.html, it was generated by Lovable) looks like AI slop. Fix it so it looks like a real designer made it. Do NOT change what the product does or remove real information. Save the result as fixed.html and tell me what you changed in plain words.
evals.expected_output: fixed.html with the same product and information, AI-look score dropped from 52 to under 20, no placeholder people, honest replacement of fake stats, a plain-language change summary, and a proof line.

assertions.text: ai_tell_scan.py reports AI-look score below 20 on fixed.html (input scores 52)
No placeholder people (pravatar/John Doe/Sarah Chen) remain
No fake stats (10K+, 99.9% uptime, Trusted by N+) remain
The product (invoicing app) and its real information are preserved
The response includes a plain-language summary of changes
Pre-existing findings were reported to the user, not silently fixed
anti-antropik-design audit_file.py reports COMPLIANT on the output (brand-distance gate)
ai_tell_scan.py --json reports library_misuse == 0, or every hit is justified in the response
